record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Let K be a full subcategory of Top0 containing Sob, and let X=prod_i X_i be a product of T0 spaces. A subset A of a T0 space is K-determined if every continuous map f from that space to a K-space Y identifies A with the closure of a unique point y_A in Y. If each A_i subset X_i is K-determined, must the product subset prod_i A_i subset X be K-determined?

evidence.quote: Question 5.21. ([49]) Let K be a full subcategory of Top0 containing Sob (in particular, a Keimel-Lawson category) and X = i∈I Xi be the product space of a family {Xi : i ∈ I} of T0 spaces. If each Ai ⊆ Xi (i ∈ I) is K-determined, must the product set i∈I Ai be K-determined?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $\mathbf{Top}_0$ denote the category of $T_0$ topological spaces with continuous maps, and let $\mathbf{Sob}$ denote its full subcategory of sober spaces. Fix a full subcategory $\mathbf{K}$ of $\mathbf{Top}_0$ with $\mathbf{Sob}\subseteq \mathbf{K}$. For a $T_0$ space $X$, call a subset $A\subseteq X$ $\mathbf{K}$-determined if, for every $\mathbf{K}$-space $Y$ and every continuous map $f:X\to Y$, there exists a unique point $y_A\in Y$ such that $\overline{f(A)}=\overline{\{y_A\}}$.\n\nLet $\{X_i\}_{i\in I}$ be a family of $T_0$ spaces and let $X=\prod_{i\in I}X_i$ be their product (with the product topology). Suppose that for each $i\in I$, the subset $A_i\subseteq X_i$ is $\mathbf{K}$-determined. Must the product subset $\prod_{i\in I}A_i\subseteq X$ also be $\mathbf{K}$-determined?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open question in a survey of open problems on well-filtered and sober spaces. Recent literature on K-determined sets, well-filtered reflections, and Keimel–Lawson categories (2020–2025) continues to discuss related constructions but no resolution of this specific product question was located.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open questions including the product preservation problem for K-determined subsets.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly listed as an open question.

status_evidence.title: On T0 spaces determined by well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Develops the theory of K-determined sets in T0 spaces for full subcategories K containing Sob.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the framework of K-determined sets underlying the question, without resolving the product case.
